meta.name: human-in-the-loop
meta.description: Designing intervention points where humans review, approve, or redirect agent work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计人工审核节点，把控智能体工作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要让智能体在关键步骤等待人工确认或干预
copy.tagline_en: Design human review points to control agent workflow quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need agents to pause for human approval or intervention at key steps

howto.what: Claude 会在工作流程中设置人工干预点，在关键步骤前暂停，等你审核、批准或重定向后再继续执行。
howto.when: 当任务涉及高风险（如不可逆操作）、系统对答案不确定，或你明确要求人工参与时触发。

say.text: 发送这封邮件前需要你批准。
say.note: Claude 会暂停并等待你确认。

say.text: 我拿不准这个建议对不对，请审查。
say.note: Claude 会展示详情供你判断。

say.text: 执行删除前请先让我确认。
say.note: Claude 会停止操作等你指令。

howto.what_en: Claude will insert human intervention points in workflows, pausing at key steps for you to review, approve, or redirect before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggered by high-stakes actions, low confidence, novel situations, ethical judgments, legal requirements, or user request.

say_en.text: I need your approval before sending this email.
say_en.note: Claude pauses and waits for confirmation.

say_en.text: I'm uncertain about this suggestion; please review it.
say_en.note: Claude shows details for your judgment.

say_en.text: Please confirm before I delete anything.
say_en.note: Claude stops and waits for your instruction.
